copy.curiosityHook: With a high school routine to maintain and an unintended vanish, how long can two very different sisters keep an invisible reality under wraps?
copy.description: When teen Cleo's school science experiment spirals out of control, the unexpected fallout leaves her popular older sister Molly completely invisible, sparking a frantic scramble to navigate everyday life.
copy.vibeSummary: Light, energetic fantasy-comedy with an easygoing rhythm that fits a lively movie night with family or friends.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Paul Hoen, this brisk 78-minute fantasy-comedy offers an easy, fast-paced family adventure shaped by lighthearted mishap and playful sisterly chaos.

allowedMaterial: Cleo's school science project going awry
The sisters' relationship and initial fallout
excludedMaterial: Methods used to reverse the invisibility
Late relationship outcomes or ending revelations
